newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-NATAL OPT TO BAT AGAINST TRANSVAAL.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-NATAL OPT TO BAT AGAINST TRANSVAAL.

text.p: Natal won the toss and chose to bat in their four-day Supersport series match against Transvaal in Johannesburg on Friday.
Transvaal - Adam Bacher, Mark Benfield, Neil McKenzie, Daryll Cullinan, Ken Rutherford (captain), Zander de Bruyn, Nic Pothas, Ross Veenstra, Stefan Jacobs, Clive Eksteen, Wayne Kidwell.
Natal - Andrew Hudson, Dougie Watson, Errol Stewart, Derek Crookes, Jonty Rhodes, Dale Benkenstein (captain), Neil Johnson, Shaun Pollock, Lance Klusener, Pat Symcox, Keith Forde.
